create_VizSeqLogger: create a VizSeqLogger instance that logs to console with formatted timestamps and elapsed time
use_VizSeqLogger_info: use the VizSeqLogger.info method to log informational messages with elapsed time prefix
use_VizSeqLogger_warning: use the VizSeqLogger.warning method to log warning messages with elapsed time prefix
use_VizSeqLogFormatter: use the VizSeqLogFormatter class to format log records with level, date, elapsed time, and message
use_logger_singleton: use the logger singleton to log info and warning messages throughout the vizseq application
